name: Waternet
author: Davy Willems
description: A pipe puzzle: connect every pipe so water flows from the source by rotating pipes, sliding rows and columns, or both in Roslid mode. X to act, Z to go back.

descriptions.en: A pipe puzzle: connect every pipe so water flows from the source by rotating pipes, sliding rows and columns, or both in Roslid mode. X to act, Z to go back.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle di tubi: collega tutte le condutture perché l'acqua scorra dalla sorgente, ruotando i tubi, spostando righe e colonne o entrambe le cose. X agisci, Z indietro.
